title: unified-rollouts-extend-metric-driven-rollback-to-shadow-and-ab-flows
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: extend the existing metric-driven auto-rollback capability to cover shadow traffic and A/B test flows. Previously auto-rollback only operated against active canaries; customers running shadow or parallel A/B experiments hit a gap where regressions in metrics (latency/error/relevance) were not automatically surfaced or rolled back. This PR adds scope-aware rollback evaluation, per-traffic-type thresholds, and a simulation mode for safe rollout testing. Checklist: - [x] Design and spec (ENG-3542) - [x] Controller changes to evaluate shadow/ab traffic scoring - [x] Add per-scope threshold config and defaults - [x] Backcompat: default policies unchanged unless scope explicitly set - [x] Observability: emit per-scope metric deltas and decision traces - [x] Tests: unit + integration harness - [x] Docs and playbook update - [x] DB migration for rollout scope metadata Summary of changes: implements a scope-aware metric aggregator, extends the rollback decision engine to evaluate shadow and A/B cohorts independently (with configurable aggregation window), updates rollout API to accept traffic_scope config (canary|shadow|ab), and introduces a simulation flag that runs the decision engine without initiating traffic changes. Backwards compatibility: existing rollout definitions that omit traffic_scope behave exactly as before. Linked work: ENG-3542, ENG-3610. Note: initial CI run surfaced a flaky e2e in the integration test which required tightening the traffic harness timing; second CI passed and I squashed the fix into the final commit.
